newsitem.title: USA: CBOE says S&P 100, S&P 500 index options open.
newsitem.headline: CBOE says S&P 100, S&P 500 index options open.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE) said Tuesday trading in options on the S&P 100 and S&P 500 stock indexes opened at 0843 CST/1443 GMT.

The openings had been delayed from their normal 0830 CST 1430 GMT start because of a sharp opening rally in the S&P 500 March futures contract, which rose to its five-point opening price limit in early pit trading.
The CBOE said fast market conditions were in effect in both the S&P 100 and S&P 500 index options pits.
